findings.title: Create decision lost-ACK reload drops idempotency identity
findings.owner: WP01/WP11 UI and case writer; integrator71

source.evidence: intention/key retained only in current browser closure; new page generates fresh randomUUID on re-submit
idempotency is tied to original operation and command digest
test intercepts lost response via CDP to obtain outputRef and reloads known case; does not reload unknown original creation form

findings.impact: After real server commit with POST response lost, reload leaves no original key; a new submission can create a distinct case or no actionable recovery. Duplication is a risk, not yet an observed run failure.
findings.required_correction: Durable, privacy-scoped authoritative lookup/replay of original creation intention without guessing timestamp or redispatching with fresh key. Browser UI must recover after reload and restart while preserving principal/access revocation.
findings.reproduction_for_45: Hold or discard response after committed POST to sf_case_draft; reload original create form with no outputRef observed; prove same one saved case/receipt after recovery, no second mutation, include restart and revoked access.
findings.recheck: Inspect fix commit/preimages in frozen C and exact UI/host/server E2E one-effect proof, run/artifacts and independent delta review

findings.title: Legacy export bytes can egress after stale or revoked authorization

source.evidence: transaction authenticates and snapshots before download(); after generation, only request.signal checked before Response(file.bytes); no current role/source fence.

findings.impact: Permission revoked or source mutated while file generation runs can cause release of captured privileged or outdated report. Direct repro pending.
findings.required_correction: Compose egress reauthorization + source-version digest after generation and before byte return, respecting HEAD, 403/revocation and 409/source-changed, privacy.
findings.reproduction_for_45: Start authorized download then pause downstream generator; revoke role or change source version, resume and assert 403 or 409 with zero private bytes. Positive same-source control remains identical.
findings.recheck: Blob in composed frozen C must include protection; verify actual complete legacy and UI export cases with late revocation and source change
